title: Yosemite Valley Tunnel View Landscape, 1950s California B&W Snapshot Photo
location: Yosemite National Park, California, United States
description: A classic panoramic scenic view of Yosemite Valley from Tunnel View in Yosemite National Park, California. The composition captures El Capitan rising grandly on the left, Bridalveil Fall cascading down the granite cliffs of Cathedral Rocks on the right, and Half Dome looming in the hazy distance beyond the densely forested valley floor. The print features decorative scalloped deckled edges characteristic of mid-20th-century vacation snapshot prints.
